_readme: Marsad parallel (black) market rate. Edit usdLyd, updated and sources, then redeploy. Set usdLyd to null when you have no verified figure - the app and site hide the section rather than show a number nobody has checked. usdLyd is the CASH rate (physical notes), not the cheque/sak rate, which trades at a premium. 'note' is an optional context line under the figure. It is a single space on purpose: app 2.0.1 falls back to a built-in 'unofficial estimate' disclaimer whenever note is empty, and a space is the only way to suppress that. Once 2.0.2 has rolled out to everyone this can go back to "" - 2.0.2 shows no line at all when note is empty.
